title: Documents library
goal: Find a document and open it, or start a new one.

zones.name: header
zones.purpose: Name the screen and offer the one creating action.

zones.name: toolbar
zones.purpose: Narrow the list by text and by status. Laid out by the screen, not by <Row>.

zones.name: content
zones.purpose: One card per document: title, status, when it was last touched. The grid is .document-grid, a container query in the page CSS rather than <Grid>, because the column count follows the content column and not the viewport.

states.empty: EmptyState via the template's empty prop, icon=folder, offering to clear the filters
states.error: Alert tone=danger above the grid, with a retry action

data: documents: id, title, status (draft | review | published), updatedAt — mock data for now
openQuestions: Does the list need pagination, or is the working set small enough to render at once?
Make useSimpleFit measure against whatever wrapper it is inside, then move this screen onto <AdaptiveListPage>. The attempt is described in _templateNote.
_templateNote: The screen predates this block and still composes the shape by hand: it calls useSimpleFit itself and lays the welcome cluster out in .library markup rather than <ListCluster>. Moving it was TRIED on 2026-07-31 and reverted: the screen came up in the standard header layout instead of the welcome one, because the block measures the fit against its own wrapper rather than .page-content. That is a behaviour change on the design system's showcase screen, not a refactor. The block gained what the move showed it was missing (empty.reason='no-matches', so a filtered-empty list keeps its search box); the screen stays as it is until the fit measurement is made wrapper-agnostic.

behaviours.given: several authors' documents existing, Mohammed signed in
behaviours.then: only Mohammed's documents appear — another author's work is absent from HIS library
behaviours.why: The screen is called My Content, and the name is the promise.

behaviours.given: the standard library with its toolbar
behaviours.when: the author types part of a title
behaviours.then: the grid narrows to matching titles and non-matching cards leave
behaviours.why: Find is the toolbar zone's declared task.

behaviours.when: the last card leaves the grid
behaviours.then: an empty state explains the situation instead of a blank grid
behaviours.why: Every list's empty case must speak (the states contract).
